name: CUAEWS DF (SRC, LIDS EW)
description: LIDS/M-LIDS electronic-attack element. Passively searches RF, direction-finds both aircraft and operator, then applies tailored non-kinetic defeat plus a NAVWAR effect against waypoint-guided threats. SRC states EW effects to 8 km. Man-in-the-loop fires; re-tasking is near instantaneous and indefinite.

minRangeM.condition: minimum engagement range — No minimum standoff is published for an EW effector. 0 is the schema convention for 'no inner keep-out', not a measured value.
minRangeM.source: SRC, LIDS Family of Systems brochure

maxRangeM.condition: EW effects ranging up to 8 km (8000 m)
maxRangeM.source: SRC LIDS Family of Systems brochure (PDF)

maxAltitudeFt.condition: engagement altitude ceiling — No altitude ceiling is published for CUAEWS. null, never 0.
maxAltitudeFt.source: SRC, LIDS Family of Systems brochure

sectorDeg.condition: azimuth coverage — SRC publishes no azimuth sector. Basis for 360: the system is a guyed tower emplacement (156.5 in tower, 38 in diameter) with a multi-band direction finder using 'multiple detectors' and it 'automatically resumes passive RF search' after each engagement, which is a persistent all-round posture. This is INFERRED and must not be read as a measured beam.
sectorDeg.source: SRC, LIDS Family of Systems brochure, CUAEWS DF section

engageTimeS.condition: time from assignment to effect — No numeric figure published. SRC states 'Defeat techniques are automatically prepped and ready to fire', 'A man in the loop activates the defeat technique', and 'Re-load/re-tasking is near instantaneous and indefinite'. 5 s is the app's existing representative for a human-authorised RF engagement (matches lib-modi and lib-dronebuster). REPRESENTATIVE.
engageTimeS.source: SRC, LIDS Family of Systems brochure, CUAEWS DF section

pk.condition: probability the jam produces the modelled effect — UNKNOWN. No public Pk, defeat rate, or test statistic exists for CUAEWS. 0.65 is a REPRESENTATIVE planning value carried over from the app's existing lib-modi jammer entry so the EW class stays internally consistent. It is not evidence.
